title: nf-core/nanoseq pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

group.errorMessage: Group name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

replicate.errorMessage: Replicate must be an integer starting from 1

barcode.errorMessage: Barcode must be a positive integer or left empty

input_file.errorMessage: Input file cannot contain spaces. It must be a '.fastq.gz', '.fq.gz' or '.bam' file, or a directory of raw (FAST5/POD5) data. Leave empty when demultiplexing with '--input_path'.
